pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.faq1q: Can I change my plan later?
pricing.faq1a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings. Changes will take effect immediately.
pricing.faq2q: How do the generation credits work?
pricing.faq2a: Each video generation costs 30 credits (standard) or 60 credits (premium). Your credits reset every month on your billing date.
pricing.faq3q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq3a: We accept credit cards, bank transfers, and PIX through our secure payment partner Vexutopia.
pricing.faq4q: Is there a free trial for Plus and Prime?
pricing.faq4a: We offer a 7-day free trial for our Plus plan for new users to explore all the premium features.

support.faq2q: How long does video generation take?
support.faq2a: Generation times vary depending on server load, but most videos are ready within 30 seconds to 2 minutes.
